description_en: Modifies the permission attributes of resource collaborative authorization
description_zh: 修改资源协同授权的权限属性
name: UpdateAuthorizationAttributes

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

dashboard: dashboard.
screen: data visualization.
report: workbook.
ANALYSIS: ad hoc analysis.
dashboardOfflineQuery: self-service data retrieval.
dataForm: data form.
cube: dataset.
datasource: data source
parameters.help_zh:
作品类型：

仪表板：dashboard
数据大屏：screen
电子表格：report
即席分析：ANALYSIS
自助取数：dashboardOfflineQuery
数据填报：dataForm
数据集：cube
数据源：datasource
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource to modify
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The edit permission type. Valid values:

0: Private.
11: All workspace members except guests. For data forms, datasets, and data sources, this value indicates all workspace developers.
12: Specified members. For data forms, datasets, and data sources, this value indicates specified developers
parameters.help_zh:
编辑权限类型

0：私有
11：除访客外的全部空间成员，对于数据填报、数据集和数据源来说为全部空间开发者
12：指定成员，对于数据填报、数据集和数据源来说为指定开发者
parameters.name: edit_permission_type

parameters.help_en:
The usage permission type for datasets and data sources. Valid values:

1: All workspace members except guests.
2: Specified members
parameters.help_zh:
数据集和数据源的使用权限类型

1：除访客外的全部空间成员
2：指定成员
